summary.bn: counter, sentinel আর digit-এর কাজ while দিয়ে করো এবং থামার কারণ trace করো।

notes: While is part of C89 and remains unchanged in C17. The digit programs use C99-or-later division rules, though their nonnegative values avoid negative-remainder differences. C17 is the build baseline.

examples.title: A visible counter trace
examples.explanationHtml: The three body lines show one through three. The final line shows four, the value that fails the next test. The terminating counter can differ from the last printed body value by one step.

examples.title: Sum decimal digits
examples.explanationHtml: Each pass extracts the low decimal digit and removes it from n. Zero digits contribute nothing but still require a division step. The final sum is twelve. The working number reaches zero, so the next condition fails.

examples.title: Reverse a bounded number
examples.explanationHtml: The first extracted zero leaves the initial result zero. The next digit gives two, then the final digit produces twenty-one. The integer result does not keep a leading zero. All intermediate values fit the small bounded example.

examples.title: Read until a sentinel
examples.explanationHtml: The input supplies two marks and then negative one. Only the marks are counted, giving count two and total one hundred twenty. The sentinel is checked before the body. A failed read also ends repetition without reusing a previous mark.

practice.title: Print a countdown
practice.statementHtml: Read n 0 to 10. After the prompt Input: , print n through 1, each on a line, then Done.

practice.title: Digit sum
practice.statementHtml: Read n 0 to 999999. After the prompt Input: , print its digit sum and newline.
hints: The zero input sum is already zero.

practice.title: Reverse a number
practice.statementHtml: Read n 0 to 999999. After the prompt Input: , print the numerically reversed digits and newline; leading zeroes disappear.
hints: Move the extracted digit into the accumulating result.

practice.title: A bounded sentinel total
practice.statementHtml: Read up to 100 nonnegative marks 0 to 100 followed by -1. After the prompt Input: , print count and sum separated by a space and newline.

quiz.prompt: When is a while condition tested?
quiz.explanation: A false test skips the next body.

quiz.prompt: What progress does n /= 10 provide for positive digit work?
options: It removes the last decimal digit
It reverses all digits at once
quiz.explanation: A positive integer eventually reaches zero.

quiz.prompt: Which operator extracts the last nonnegative decimal digit?
quiz.explanation: Remainder after division by ten is the low digit.

quiz.prompt: Should a sentinel be added to a marks total?
quiz.explanation: Its role is termination rather than data.

quiz.prompt: Why preserve original before reversing n?
options: The working n is consumed by division
quiz.explanation: The original is needed for a later comparison.

quiz.prompt: How many body executions occur when a while starts false?
What is dangerous about retrying a failed numeric scanf unchanged?
options: The same bad character may remain unread
quiz.explanation: Without consumption or exit, failure can repeat forever.

quiz.prompt: After printing 1 through 3, which stopping counter is reported?
quiz.explanation: The update from three to four leads to the failed condition.

quiz.prompt: The digit sum includes two zeroes. What total results?
quiz.explanation: Only five and seven contribute to the sum.

quiz.prompt: Removing trailing zeroes during numeric reversal gives what value?
quiz.explanation: Integer twenty-one has no stored leading zero.

keyPoints.bn: while প্রতিবার body-এর আগে শর্ত দেখে।

keyPoints.en: A false first test gives zero iterations.
keyPoints.bn: প্রথম শর্ত মিথ্যা হলে body একবারও চলে না।

keyPoints.en: Sentinel input is excluded from the data.
keyPoints.bn: sentinel-কে সাধারণ data হিসেবে হিসাব করো না।

keyPoints.en: Divide by ten to remove a nonnegative decimal digit.

keyPoints.en: Preserve the original before destructive digit work.
keyPoints.bn: digit কাটার আগে দরকার হলে আসল সংখ্যাটি রেখে দাও।

examQuestions.question: When is a while condition tested?
examQuestions.answerHtml: Before every body execution. A false test skips the next body.

examQuestions.question: What progress does n /= 10 provide for positive digit work?
examQuestions.answerHtml: It removes the last decimal digit. A positive integer eventually reaches zero.

examQuestions.question: Read up to 100 nonnegative marks 0 to 100 followed by -1. After Input: print count and sum separated by a space and newline.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>

int main(void)
{
    int mark;
    int count = 0;
    int sum = 0;
    printf("Input: ");
    while (scanf("%d", &mark) == 1 && mark != -1) {
        if (mark < 0 || mark > 100 || count == 100) {
            return 1;
        }
        sum += mark;
        count++;
    }
    printf("%d %d\n", count, sum);
    return 0;
}

Stop before adding the sentinel.
